issues: 两版 dashboard 都是本文件手抄的旧灰阶骨架（2px 灰边、灰条），与升级后的 FakeDashboard 完全不一致
没有导出时长，工作台按 default 渲 150f，64f 坐实之后死寂 86f
扫场没有起因：画面静置 14f 后边界凭空出现
边界是一根 4px 纯白线 + 白辉光，在浅色侧几乎看不见，读不出"深色幕布压过来"；坐实 0.995 肉眼不可见
changes: 两版直接用 <FakeDashboard tone="light"/"dark" />，同布局逐像素一致，扫场只换肤
补导出 THEME_SWEEP_TOGGLE_DURATION = 120（64f 后静止 56f）；14/52/64 关键帧、15° 斜边、out poly3 曲线与超扫量不变
顶栏搜索框左侧加主题开关：f6–13 旋钮带轻微过冲拨到右侧、太阳交叉淡成月亮、轨道转强调色，扫场下一帧开始；深色版里开关是同位置的开启态
边界改为 2px 亮线核心 + 偏向深色侧的强调色辉光（宽度随边界速度 22→92px 拉伸）+ 投在浅色侧的 160px 柔影，读作幕布扫过；坐实改 0.99→1
issuesEn: Both dashboards were hand-copied old grey skeletons in this file (2px grey borders, grey bars), nothing like the upgraded FakeDashboard
No exported duration, so the workbench rendered the 150f default with 86f of dead air after the 64f settle
The sweep had no cause: after 14f of stillness the edge simply appears
The edge was a 4px pure-white line with white glow, nearly invisible over the light side and not reading as a dark curtain; the 0.995 settle was imperceptible
changesEn: Both versions are <FakeDashboard tone="light"/"dark" /> with pixel-identical layout, so the sweep only re-skins
Exported THEME_SWEEP_TOGGLE_DURATION = 120 (56f still after 64f); the 14/52/64 keyframes, 15° slant, out-poly3 curve and overscan are unchanged

A theme switch sits left of the top-bar search: at f6–13 the knob flips right with a slight overshoot, the sun cross-fades to a moon and the track turns accent, and the sweep starts the next frame; the dark version shows the switch on in the same spot

The edge is a 2px bright core with an accent glow trailing on the dark side (width stretching 22→92px with edge speed) and a 160px soft shadow cast on the light side, reading as a curtain passing; the settle is now 0.99→1
